coordinates: azimuth in degrees anticlockwise toward listener left; elevation above horizontal; distance in metres
sample_conversion: 24-bit PCM left-justified int32 / 2**31 -> float32; exact PCM amplitude representation
normalization: None: no per-direction, per-ear, per-frequency, or global gain normalization
measurement_system: Official description states an equalised Equator D5 loudspeaker at 1.5 m; no separate microphone/system calibration or inverse filter is supplied in the archive
anatomical_response: Official RAW branch, distinct from DFC and MINP. No DF average or ear-canal baseline has been divided out by this conversion. No individual listener match is claimed.
low_frequency_limit: The published RAW responses retain a low-frequency roll-off. No low-frequency extension or compensation is added. Equalised measurement loudspeaker does not establish a perfectly flat full measurement chain.
magnitude_summary_note: Data-description values only; arithmetic power average over unique directions, not solid-angle weighted and never applied to the signal
propagation_delay_removed_samples_scope: Samples removed by this conversion only, not a claim about undocumented upstream trimming
source_reference_flight_delay: Full 1.5 m flight time is not retained as a literal leading delay: at 343 m/s it is about 210 samples at 48 kHz, whereas frontal peaks are at sample 49. This is an inference from the published impulse timing.
timing_policy: All published samples retained without shifts, circular shifts, per-ear alignment, onset trimming, or ITD reconstruction. Add physical room propagation delay once; retain the dataset's existing common processing offset. Do not subtract 1.5/c from these already time-windowed responses.
itd_table_note: Official MINP branch lookup table retained as a reference only; not applied to RAW HRIRs, which already carry interaural delays.
comment: Official SADIE I Subject 001 KEMAR RAW HRIR WAV measurements; no diffuse-field equalization applied by this conversion; not SADIE II D2 and not reconstructed from a DF or JM-1 curve.
dataset: SADIE I, Subject 001 KEMAR, official RAW branch
authors: Cal Armstrong, Lewis Thresh, Gavin Kearney; Audio Lab, University of York
